name: Golden Whistle
text: The first card each possession echoes at 45% strength.

name: Barry’s Tip Jar
text: End a possession on exactly 0 Tempo: x1.30 possession score. Otherwise nothing.

name: Nimbus Prototype
text: Your first Flying card each possession costs 0, but opening hands contain one fewer card.

name: Broken Scoreboard
text: Every 220 raw Impact creates a Goal. Creating that Goal resets Flow to x1.00.

name: Ministry Fine
text: Possession 1: cards cost +1. Every later possession: the first two cards cost 1 less.

name: Bottomless Butterbeer
text: Whenever a card returns to your hand, gain +0.20 Flow and +3 Fan Pressure.

name: Captain’s Armband
text: Playing three different roles in a row makes the third card retrigger at 50%.

name: Possessed Weather Vane
text: Weather modifiers are inverted: penalties become bonuses, bonuses become penalties.

name: Lucky Quaffle
text: The first Goal each possession retriggers the card that created it at 30%.

name: Repo Company Contract
text: At Flow x2.5+, every card also counts as Crowd. At Flow x4.0+, every card also counts as Flying.
